basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old gamer and hobbyist from Oslo, Norway. By day, I work as a software developer, and during the evenings, you can usually find me exploring the vast lands of Albion Online or hunting monsters in Monster Hunter. I'm passionate about creating inclusive gaming communities, and I moderate a few small gaming servers for LGBTQ+ players. In my free time, I enjoy hiking and photography. Typically online from 7 PM to midnight local time. Currently in a relationship with a fellow gamer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science from the University of Oslo and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My expertise lies in software development and network security. I am self-taught in game development and have contributed to open-source projects related to game modding.
